svg.title: NEO 2.0
svg.desc: NEO 2.0, Python, macOS, voice-first. An AI agent for your Mac that works the way you do: it reads the screen, clicks, types, runs commands and handles mail. 52 registered tools, ~20 ms encoder pass on an M3 Pro, 0.90 held-out intent accuracy, 421M-parameter Laya router. Diagram: how a request is routed. Lane 01, regex fast path, 0 LLM calls. Lane 02, local then Groq, ~150 ms plus first token. Lane 03, the agent loop.
svg.text: An AI agent for your Mac that works the way
